answer: A farm needs 379 separate restaked positions, since one pool share cannot cover 379 identities. Restaking pools security from many stakers, and the attestation proves the pooled stake backs the service. The kernel check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The attestation is verified on-chain, and the pooled stake is audited each epoch. The jade record is public, the atlas cost is per identity, and 379 aliases cost 379 times one honest seat.
